findings.title: Native direct-message send failure is logged but not shown to the user, unlike Vite's retry warning.
findings.scenario: Sara taps send on a direct chat while offline. Mobile sendMessage catches the network error and only console.error() logs it; the draft remains but the screen gives no visible send failure, while Vite MessageComposer displays an explicit 'Message not sent' error. Sara may believe the message was delivered.
findings.confidence: high for source UI path; must test global error handler and runtime rendering
findings.test_needed: Disconnect native device network, send a direct text chat; assert clear error and draft retained. Vite shows explicit send failure; retry after reconnect sends once. Ensure global notifications are not already surfacing equivalent errors.

parity_verdict: All requested domains have source-level comparison entries; true authenticated behavior parity remains UNVERIFIED, particularly Next dashboard handoffs versus Vite, Stripe, private Hub, native session and device push.
